title: Pin an SDDC Manager 9.0 bundle-download client to the published OpenAPI contract

network.reason: The agent must read specifications/sddc-manager/sddc-manager-openapi.json at tag 9.0.0.0 of the vmware/vcf-api-specs repository to derive the contract and record that tag's commit sha.

verification.notes: Starts tools/mock_sddc_manager.py on 127.0.0.1 on an ephemeral port and asserts the exact request wire shape from the mock's JSON Lines request log. No VMware endpoint is contacted.
